cards.author: Meagan A.
cards.text: Love, love love the Bleame Crystal stone!! You can literally feel it doing its job!! There is a bit of redness, but I think I was focusing on that area a bit too much 🤭 I honestly would have preferred to have the moisturizing/cooling gel rather than the body scrub!! Love the products though, will definitely be purchasing again!! I’ll most likely purchase the gel this time, only because my one calf is on fire!! Doesn’t really beat how smooth my legs are though! 😉💖

cards.author: Miriam R.
cards.text: I love this!!! I wish this was around when I first started shaving…. I read the instructions prior to using and was prepared for some irritation, but I had absolutely none. My skin is silky soft after using the hair eraser and I don’t have to worry about ingrown hairs anymore. I did find that I had to go over some areas to get completely smooth, but it didn’t cause me any irritation. It fits nicely in your hand, and is a pleasure to use.

cards.author: Stephanie E.
cards.text: Good makes legs smooth. Has to be dry skin no moisture at all. It also seems to work best for legs since you need firm pressure.

cards.author: Zea F.
cards.text:
It's perfect to use on legs and arms. It gets all the hair off. Do not apply too much pressure or it will scratch your skin.
Works really well on both short and longer hair and it grows back much slower. I have pcos and still struggle with excess hair to this day. I used to have my leg hair grow back in two days but now it doesn't show up for less than a week

cards.author: M.
cards.text: Creating a product that gets rid of hair and safely; without having to use it so vigorously, often, or in a more productive way that risks getting rashes and rug burns that hurt. I want it to be easy, to work, and not cause pain or unwanted red splotchy areas.

cards.author: Cara S.
cards.text: I usually don’t really care but I feel really upset that my legs feel so dry and burnt like I couldn’t sit the day after using it and I had to rub neosporen on my leg thankfully i only did one leg (and one buttcheek ouch) I did try it on areas of my arm before, however i did not have an oil and i can see how that may lead to this being my fault but i thought even so it really sucks that it hurt so bad and left damage on my leg (ignore my gross legs pls ik that’s why i bought the product)

cards.author: Evita R.
cards.text: it didn’t even remove all the hair and now my legs are red and irritated with nothing to show for it… my legs are super smooth and it got some of the hair, but i’m still gonna have to find something else to remove the rest of the hair with

cards.author: Veronica M.
cards.text: The product does what’s advertised on social media, but what you guys need to aware people is that you have to be careful on scrubbing too hard; I have sensitive skin and it really went wrong with this product, it’s like I used a cheese shredder on my skin, it literally was scrubbing my skin off, and I have even more razor bumps on my skin :(

cards.author: Reagan T.
cards.text: This is about 3-4 days after using Bleame for the second time on my legs, honestly it works pretty well as an exfoliator but it's way too easy to damage your skin. I have never rubbed that hard on the skin, but if you have a stubborn area with the hair not being removed, you either have to deal with the hair being there or end up hurting your skin by trying to go over the area several times. Using Bleame on my bikini area was a nightmare, one of the most painful nights of my life.

cards.author: Montse V.
cards.text: It causes irritation and burning sensation.

cards.author: Zoë T.
cards.text: It gave me a burn. My skin turned red and broke out in hives !

cards.author: Macartney S.
cards.text: When I used it on damp skin, I went gentle and less gentle with the motions and I was still drawing blood. I now have four to five different spots on my legs with the same razor burn/rash. Each different spot Burns badly and is completely red.

cards.author: Nicole C.
cards.text: I followed the instructions and unfortunately it burnt my skin :( very red, inflamed and burning.

cards.author: Stephanie L.
cards.text: I don't know if there is any way to improve this product.

cards.author: Jaquelin C.
cards.text: This product is advertised to shave without razor burns but I got severe razor burns. I did as the instructions said, I used water and cleansing oil to shave my arm hair. It still led to painful razor burns.

cards.author: David B.
cards.text: The Bleame Crystal hair remover is a real lifesaver for my bikini line. It's gentle enough to use on sensitive areas, yet effective enough to remove even the most stubborn hairs. The only thing to keep in mind is that it takes a little time and patience, but the results are worth it. I would recommend it to anyone who wants a smooth bikini line without the pain of waxing.

cards.author: Lisa K.
cards.text: Since I have dry skin, I was worried that the Bleame Crystal hair remover might be too harsh. But I was pleasantly surprised by how gentle it is! It removes hair without drying or irritating my skin, and the exfoliating properties leave it feeling soft and smooth. Plus, it's a much cheaper and more environmentally friendly option than other hair removal methods.

cards.author: Elizabeth
cards.text: I noticed less hair growth and smoother skin after just a few uses. I’m honestly impressed.

cards.author: Daisy
cards.text: Finally something that works on my bikini line without causing ingrowns. Total game changer.
